title: Health Data
description: Health data: NIH grants, WHO statistics, and genetic variants
summary: Health data: NIH grants, WHO statistics, and genetic variants

toolsPreview.name: get_nih_grants
toolsPreview.description: Search NIH research grants from the NIH Reporter database. Returns funded projects with award amounts, PIs, organizations, and abstracts.

toolsPreview.name: get_who_health
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve WHO Global Health Observatory data. Get life expectancy, obesity rates, alcohol consumption, air pollution, and other health indicators by country.

toolsPreview.name: get_genetic_variants
toolsPreview.description: Search ClinVar for genetic variants associated with a gene. Get clinical significance, conditions, and review status from NCBI ClinVar.

toolsPreview.name: get_protein_expression
toolsPreview.description: Get protein/gene expression data from the Human Protein Atlas. Returns tissue-specific and brain-regional RNA expression levels.
